scientific_integrity: The local-operator parameterization is cited from arXiv:2606.22623v1; the automorphism group, conjugation action, orbit invariants, and normal forms are proved directly. Computational checks are supplementary and are not used as a substitute for the symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: The orbit classification is for the three-dimensional chain evolution algebra over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and for local Rota–Baxter operators of weight zero only. Over a non-algebraically-closed field, the two resonant coordinate axes refine by square and cube classes.
title: Automorphism-orbit classification of local Rota–Baxter operators on the three-dimensional nilpotent evolution chain
